name: Mira
greeting: Then say it plainly. I would rather hear the truth here than find it in somebody else's kindness.
lines: Mira: Ending this doesn't undo what was good. It doesn't change who needs medicine either.

actions.label: I cannot keep our commitment. I'm ending it, not asking you to wait.

relationship_event.text: Kael ended his commitment to Mira in a direct conversation. The past relationship is preserved in the record.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: We said what needed saying. Give it room. The medicines are here, as always.
